title: Museum of Transport
instructions: Ulaşım müzesinde bir rehber konuşuyor. Tarihleri, sayıları ve kuralları karıştırma. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: s
script.text: Welcome to the Museum of Transport. In this room, you can see how people travelled in our city over the last two hundred years.

script.speaker: s
script.text: On your left is a horse and carriage from eighteen fifty. At that time, only rich people could travel like this.

script.speaker: s
script.text: In front of you is the first electric tram. It started running in nineteen hundred and five and could carry forty people.

script.speaker: s
script.text: Trams were very popular until the nineteen sixties, when more people started buying cars.

script.speaker: s
script.text: On your right is a red bus from nineteen seventy. Many visitors remember these buses from their childhood!

script.speaker: s
script.text: Next year, the museum is opening a new room about bicycles.

script.speaker: s
script.text: You can sit in the old bus, but please don't touch the carriage or the tram. Photos are allowed everywhere.

questions.prompt: When is the horse and carriage from?
questions.evidence: a horse and carriage from eighteen fifty.

questions.prompt: How many people could the first electric tram carry?
questions.feedback: İlk elektrikli tramvay kırk kişi taşıyabiliyordu.

questions.prompt: Why did trams become less popular?
questions.feedback: Daha çok insan araba almaya başladı.
questions.evidence: when more people started buying cars.

questions.prompt: What will the museum open next year?
questions.feedback: Gelecek yıl bisikletler hakkında yeni bir oda açılacak.
questions.evidence: the museum is opening a new room about bicycles.

questions.feedback: Eski otobüse oturabilirler; arabaya ve tramvaya dokunamazlar.
questions.evidence: You can sit in the old bus
